newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Investor declines comment on Nordbanken report. [CORRECTED 09:35 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Investor declines comment on Nordbanken report. [CORRECTED 09:35 GMT]

text.p: Swedish investment group Investor AB on Friday declined to comment on a report in business newspaper Dagens Industri that it is expected to buy 20-25 percent of Nordbanken from the state. (Corrects to make clear that the deal has not yet been done.)
Dagens Industri said the deal paved the way for a merger between Nordbanken and S-E-Banken which has been widely speculated in the markets for weeks.
Sweden's Wallenberg industrial empire has Investor as its investment vehicle but also owns 15 percent of capital and 16 percent of votes in S-E-Banken.
"Out of principle we cannot comment on information of this kind," Investor spokesman Nils-Ingvar Lundin told Reuters.
